[[Quartz Crystal]] is a crafting material obtained from mining a [[Quartz Crystal Formation]]. Players can transform 25 Quartz Crystals into a [[Charged Quartz Crystal]] once per day by communing at a [[place of power]]. Players need to obtain the hero point from the place of power before the option is available.
